description: Template for PR review cycle: human reviews PR, Planner creates issues, agents resolve, PR approved

epic_id.description: Epic ID this PR belongs to (e.g. knowledge-j3a)

target_branch.description: Target branch of the PR (e.g. dev, epic/knowledge-j3a)

steps.title: Planner: Triage review comments for PR #{{pr_number}}
steps.description: Read PR #{{pr_number}} comments using gh CLI. Categorize each comment as: (1) code-fix needed, (2) refactor request, (3) question/clarification, (4) nit/style. Create child issues for actionable items. Commands: gh pr view {{pr_number}} --comments, gh api repos/OWNER/REPO/pulls/{{pr_number}}/comments

steps.title: Backend: Resolve review comments for PR #{{pr_number}}
steps.description: Address backend-related review comments from PR #{{pr_number}} ({{pr_title}}). Push fixes to the source branch. Reference the original review comment in commit messages.

steps.title: Frontend: Resolve review comments for PR #{{pr_number}}
steps.description: Address frontend-related review comments from PR #{{pr_number}} ({{pr_title}}). Push fixes to the source branch. Reference the original review comment in commit messages.

steps.title: DevOps: Resolve review comments for PR #{{pr_number}}
steps.description: Address DevOps/CI-related review comments from PR #{{pr_number}} ({{pr_title}}). Push fixes to the source branch.

steps.title: Planner: Verify all review fixes for PR #{{pr_number}}
steps.description: Verify all review comments have been addressed. Check CI status. If all fixes are satisfactory, approve the PR: gh pr review {{pr_number}} --approve -b 'All review items resolved'

steps.title: Gate: Human approval to merge PR #{{pr_number}}

gate.description: Final human approval before merging PR #{{pr_number}} to {{target_branch}}

steps.description: Human verifies all review items resolved. Merge using: gh pr merge {{pr_number}} --squash (for agent PRs) or gh pr merge {{pr_number}} --merge (for epic PRs to dev).
